title: Washing machine not draining? Arrange a repair inspection
excerpt: Water left in the drum or a stopped cycle? Arrange a washing machine inspection with Babar Shokut Electric Wear across Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman.
imageAlt: Illustrative close-up of a stainless washing machine drum
intro: Water left in the drum can leave the laundry unfinished and the door locked. If your washing machine is not draining, contact Babar Shokut Electric Wear to discuss an inspection. We serve Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman, with an inspection fee of only AED 50. Repair costs are discussed separately.
safetyNote: If water is near plugs or sockets, keep clear. Do not force the door, disconnect hoses or open a filter while water remains inside. Leave internal work to an inspection.

sections.heading: Why the symptom needs a diagnosis
paragraphs: A drainage problem does not identify a failed part on its own. A restricted filter or a hose issue can be involved, and the layout and access differ between models. An inspection helps establish what needs attention rather than starting with a guessed replacement.

Manufacturer guidance is model-specific. A repair instruction for a similar-looking washer may not apply to yours. When you contact us, describe the water remaining in the drum and any display message instead of requesting a particular component.

sections.heading: When to contact us about a washer that will not drain
paragraphs: Arrange an inspection if water remains after the programme has stopped, the same drainage problem keeps returning, or a leak or unusual noise accompanies the fault. You do not need to dismantle the appliance before making an enquiry.
If the washer is locked with water inside, tell us that when you call. Avoid forcing it open or repeatedly running another wash to see whether the problem disappears.

sections.heading: What the inspection is for
paragraphs: An inspection is the starting point for assessing the appliance and discussing the repair it may need. The appropriate next step depends on the model, condition and fault; this article cannot determine a part or a repair price from a symptom.
Tell us whether the issue started suddenly or followed a move or installation change. That context can be discussed with the fault, without moving the appliance or opening it before the visit.

The AED 50 charge is for the inspection, not the complete repair. Contact us to discuss the appliance, inspection availability and visit arrangements. Any repair work and its cost are discussed separately.

title: Fridge not cooling? Arrange a fridge repair inspection
excerpt: A fridge that is losing its cooling needs attention. Contact Babar Shokut Electric Wear about a fridge inspection for only AED 50; repair costs are separate.
imageAlt: Illustrative refrigerator interior with glass shelves
intro: If your fridge is no longer keeping its contents cold, the priority is to protect your food and arrange an assessment of the appliance. Babar Shokut Electric Wear provides fridge repair services in Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman. Contact us about an inspection for only AED 50, with repair costs discussed separately.
safetyNote: Protect food that needs refrigeration. Never taste food to decide whether it is safe. If its temperature history is uncertain, use the official food-safety reference below. Do not open electrical or refrigeration components.

sections.heading: Why a warm fridge does not identify one faulty part
paragraphs: Poor cooling can have several causes, including airflow restrictions, a door that does not close properly or an internal component problem. Lights or a running sound do not establish that the cooling system is working as it should.

An inspection helps distinguish the possible causes. Asking for a compressor replacement or another specific part before assessment can miss the actual problem. Tell us what has changed rather than trying to diagnose it yourself.

sections.heading: When to arrange a fridge inspection
paragraphs: Contact us if cooling has dropped unexpectedly, the problem keeps returning, or one compartment is affected while the other appears different. Mention any new noise, frost build-up, water leak or display error with the cooling concern.

Do not leave the business enquiry as a substitute for protecting food. Follow reliable food-safety guidance while arranging help, and keep any appliance warning signs separate from assumptions about the cause.

sections.heading: Discuss the fault before choosing a repair
paragraphs: A fridge inspection is a way to assess the reported fault and discuss the repair the appliance may need. The model, condition and findings matter; a warm compartment alone cannot establish the repair cost or whether a particular part is required.
When you contact us, describe which compartment is affected and when the change began. Share your location so inspection availability and visit arrangements can be discussed.

title: Washing machine making noise? Get the fault inspected
excerpt: Repeated banging, grinding or unusual vibration? Discuss a washing machine inspection with Babar Shokut Electric Wear before guessing which part needs replacing.
imageAlt: Illustrative close-up of a stainless washing machine drum
intro: A new banging, rattling or grinding sound can be difficult to explain over the phone. If your washing machine is making an unusual noise, Babar Shokut Electric Wear can discuss an inspection across Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman. The inspection fee is only AED 50, with repair costs discussed separately.
safetyNote: Stop using a washer that moves violently, leaks, smells of burning or repeatedly trips the electricity. Do not hold a moving machine in place, reach into it or bypass its door lock.

sections.heading: The same sound can have different explanations
paragraphs: Unusual vibration can involve the load or installation as well as a fault. Some movement during a spin is expected, but a washer that jumps or walks across the floor deserves attention. The sound alone does not confirm a failed bearing, pump or motor.
An inspection provides a better basis for discussing the repair than a diagnosis from an online video. Do not open the cabinet or try to reach an internal component to locate the noise.

sections.heading: When to contact us about a noisy washer
paragraphs: Arrange an inspection if the sound is new, keeps returning, or is accompanied by excessive movement or another change in operation. Tell us whether it happens during washing, draining or spinning, and mention any water left in the drum.

You do not need to run another cycle just to reproduce a concerning noise. If you already have a short recording taken safely, it may help you describe the issue, but it does not replace assessment of the appliance.

sections.heading: Discuss the appliance, not a guessed replacement part
paragraphs: The first enquiry should describe what you have noticed and when it began. A recent delivery, move or installation change is useful context. The condition and model of the machine also matter when discussing its repair.
Mention any separate symptoms, including a leak, a stopped programme or an error message. Share your location when enquiring about inspection availability.

title: Fridge door not sealing? Arrange a repair inspection
excerpt: A persistent door gap or damaged seal needs a closer look. Contact Babar Shokut Electric Wear about a fridge inspection in Sharjah, Dubai or Ajman.
imageAlt: Illustrative refrigerator interior with glass shelves
intro: A fridge door that will not sit closed can affect the appliance's ability to keep its contents cold. If a gap keeps returning or the seal appears damaged, contact Babar Shokut Electric Wear to discuss an inspection. We serve Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman. Inspection is only AED 50; repair costs are separate.
safetyNote: Do not heat, stretch, glue or cut the seal, loosen hinges or tilt the fridge. Keep clear of hinges and closing edges. If cooling is affected, protect perishable food using reliable food-safety guidance.

sections.heading: A door gap does not always mean the seal needs replacing
paragraphs: A damaged gasket is one possible explanation, but an obstruction, storage arrangement or door alignment issue can also affect closure. A photograph of the gap cannot establish which part, if any, needs replacing.
An inspection helps assess the door and the surrounding appliance together. Avoid ordering a seal based only on appearance or trying to reshape it with heat or adhesive.

sections.heading: When to arrange a door-seal inspection
paragraphs: Contact us if the door will not stay closed, a visible gap keeps returning, the seal is torn or loose, or cooling has changed at the same time. Tell us whether the problem affects the main door, freezer door or both.

Mention when you first noticed it, particularly if it followed a move or a change to the storage arrangement. You do not need to dismantle shelves, adjust hinges or move the fridge to prepare your enquiry.

sections.heading: Discuss the repair after assessment
paragraphs: The appropriate repair depends on the fridge model, the condition of the door and the reason it is not closing. A repair price cannot be established reliably from the words “weak seal” alone.

Share any accessible model details and tell us whether cooling has also changed. Include your location when enquiring about inspection availability; there is no need to remove the seal or adjust the door first.

title: AC running but not cooling? Arrange an inspection
excerpt: Warm air or reduced cooling? Contact Babar Shokut Electric Wear about an AC inspection across Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman. Inspection is only AED 50.
imageAlt: Wall-mounted split air conditioner above a calm, sunlit living space
intro: An AC can be running while the room stays warm. Rather than guessing that it needs a particular part or a refrigerant top-up, contact Babar Shokut Electric Wear to discuss an inspection. AC repair is available alongside our washing machine and fridge services in Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman.
safetyNote: Stop using an AC with a burning smell, repeated electrical tripping or a water leak near electrical fittings. Do not open service panels, touch wiring, handle refrigerant or climb to reach equipment.

sections.heading: Warm air does not identify the cause
paragraphs: Operating settings, airflow restrictions and other conditions can affect cooling. An AC that runs without cooling is not, by itself, proof that refrigerant is missing or a specific component has failed.
An inspection is a more useful starting point than requesting a top-up or replacement part on that assumption. Manufacturer guidance also varies by system and model.

sections.heading: When to arrange an AC inspection
paragraphs: Contact us about cooling that has changed or a recurring problem, especially if it comes with weak airflow, an unusual noise, a leak or an error display. Describe whether the air feels warm, weak or different from the unit's usual performance.
You do not need to open the unit or reach outdoor equipment to explain the issue. Share any safely visible display message and when you first noticed the change.

sections.heading: Tell us about the AC and the room affected
paragraphs: Include the type of unit, brand and any model details you already have. Mention whether one room or more than one unit is affected. Those details give the repair enquiry useful context without presenting a guess as a diagnosis.

Share your location and any building access details when discussing inspection arrangements. We can discuss the reported cooling issue with the information you already have; do not climb to inspect equipment first.
